_readme: Don't Miss placements (DEC-025). Order here is the order on the homepage; at most 3 show. Two kinds of entry: an EVENT placement {eventId, eyebrow?, reason?} featuring one existing canonical event (eventId is the id= in its event.html?id=... link; it shows only while that event is current and has an image), or a STATIC EDITORIAL card {title, copy, cta, image, image2x?, alt, focus?} such as the seasonal guides (optional root-relative href makes it a link). Optional from/to (YYYY-MM-DD) on either kind. Remove an entry to stop featuring it. Selection is editorial only and is never paid for.

placements.title: Detroit Orbit Fall Guide
placements.copy: Cider mills. Pumpkin patches. Orchards. Donuts. Hayrides. Find your fall.
placements.alt: Wooden baskets piled with red and yellow Ludicrisp apples beside a handwritten "Ludicrisp Apples $6 qt" sign at an Eastern Market stand.

placements.title: Off the Beaten Orbit
placements.copy: Potters, makers, historic houses and unexpected winter outings across the Detroit Orbit.
placements.alt: Shoppers browse rows of independent maker booths at the Detroit Urban Craft Fair.

placements.title: Fall Colors
placements.copy: Trails. Parks. Scenic drives. Waterfronts. Find the Detroit Orbit at peak color.
placements.alt: A wooden boardwalk and gravel trail leading past orange and yellow autumn trees on a sunny day.
